_guide.doc: Bai hoc kieu 'slide day hoc': sidebar trai = cac section, noi dung ben phai. Trang: bai.html?id=b1&level=mam. App bo qua key bat dau bang '_'.
_guide.section: Moi section co titleVi + titleEn. Co 'subtopics' thi hien danh sach muc con ben duoi; khong co thi bam vao se hien 'dang soan'.
_guide.subtopic.pages: Muc con co nhieu trang thi dung pages = [ {exercises:[...]}, ... ]; bam mui ten (hoac phim ← →) de chuyen trang. Chi 1 trang thi dung exercises = [...] truc tiep.
_guide.exercise.listen-choose: Nghe va khoanh tron. items = [{options:[4 dap an], answer}]. Bam so de nghe (audio = am tiet cua answer); bam dap an de khoanh; nut Hien dap an.
_guide.exercise.tones: Am tiet co thanh dieu. rows = [{label, tone: lavender|pink, words:[...]}]. Bam tung tu de nghe.
_guide.exercise.fill-blank: Nghe va dien ten. items = [{before, answer, after}]. Bam so de nghe ca cau; audio dung {n} = so thu tu cau (1,2,3...).
_guide.exercise.letters: Luoi cac chu cai. 'rows' = danh sach hang, moi hang la danh sach chu.
_guide.exercise.sounds: Cac van. 'columns' = danh sach cot; moi cot gom cac 'groups' (tone = yellow|pink|blue|violet); moi group gom cac 'rows'; o dau moi hang la nguyen am, cac o sau la am tiet. Hang ngan hon 3 o thi de trong.
_guide.audio: Mau duong dan audio cua exercise. {voice} = nam/nu, {key} = ten o viet kieu Telex (a, aw = ă, aa = â, dd = đ, ee = ê, oo = ô, ow = ơ, uw = ư). Vi du: 'đi' -> ddi, 'bơ' -> bow. Danh sach file can thu: audio/b1/_pron_filenames.txt
